Frequently asked questions

Are these phones original and checked?

Yes. Every phone passes a 21-point check — display, touch, camera, speaker, charging, Face/Fingerprint ID and IMEI — and the real battery health percentage is written on the listing. Nothing is hidden.

What warranty do I get on a used phone?

Every phone includes a 7-day replacement warranty for any hidden fault, plus after-sales service support. Just message us on WhatsApp at +880 1891-651414.

Do you deliver outside Dhaka?

Yes — courier delivery to all 64 districts of Bangladesh in 24–48 hours, with cash on delivery. You check the phone first, then pay.

Can I exchange my old phone for another one?

Yes, exchange is our most popular option. Send your old phone's model and photos on WhatsApp and we will tell you the top-up amount for the phone you want.

How do I sell my phone to you?

Fill the sell form above or message +880 1891-651414 on WhatsApp with your model, RAM/storage and a few photos. In Dhaka we can check and pay cash the same day.
